notes:
- Add Keep cover order for closed Satin and Tatami so underlay changes preserve the top stitch sequence. New Tatami objects enable it by default. Existing objects can enable it under Underlay.
- Improve Double Tatami underlay routing around cutouts. Underlay passes can change direction and reconnect their support rows around openings to reduce travel while preserving cover stitches.
- Use the same cover-order setting in the Native and Combined engines.
